PP_RumbleNote: 100 % = the profile's normal vibration. 0 % = no vibration. Over 100 % = stronger. Only used while you play this game.
PPC_RumbleSaveFailed: Could not save the vibration settings: {0}
PP_BatIntro: Warns you when a controller is running out of battery, so you can charge it before it turns off in the middle of a game.
PP_BatWarn: Warn when the battery is low
PP_BatWarnText: Shows a Windows notice once when the controller drops below the limit (no notice while it is charging).
PP_BatFlash: Flash the controller light in red
PP_BatFlashText: Below the limit, the controller light flashes red so you notice it without looking at the screen.
PPC_LowBattery: Controller {0}: battery at {1} %. Charge it soon.
PPC_BatterySaveFailed: Could not save the battery settings: {0}
